message.content: The Communications Solutions Group reported revenue of $1,345 million for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, driven by growth in commercial communications and aerospace, defense, and government [D1]. The Electronic Industrial Solutions Group reported revenue of $501 million for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, reflecting growth across semiconductor, general electronics, automotive, and energy markets [D1]. Total segment revenue reached $1,846 million for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, representing a year-over-year increase of 36.5% [D1]. Operating income for the Communications Solutions Group increased to $458 million from $246 million in the prior year period [D1].
